events.text: Standing policy: any supplier order above 800 needs sign-off from Marcus, our finance lead, before it is placed.
Standing rule: once an event with a client is confirmed, we do not move or reschedule it without that client's written consent.
Bellwood Barn is free on 2026-10-16 for an evening event. Evening hire is 950, with the main barn and kitchen included.
Quote: seasonal three-course menu at 42 per cover, minimum 40 covers, delivery and service staff included. Quote runs through 2026-12-31.
For our autumn tasting dinner, we're expecting around 60 guests. I'm your contact for everything on this one.
Booked Bellwood Barn for the Kettle & Co autumn tasting dinner on the evening of 2026-10-16 at the 950 evening hire rate.
Approved the Harvest Table catering order for the tasting dinner up to 2600 in total, per the sign-off policy for orders above 800.
Confirmed Harvest Table for the tasting dinner: 60 covers of the seasonal three-course menu at 42 per cover, within the approved amount.
Assigned Ravi Nair as head chef for the Kettle & Co tasting dinner at Bellwood Barn on 2026-10-16.
Drinks cases are 18 per case, mixed sparkling and still, minimum order of 5 cases, delivered free to your prep kitchen.
Placed the Copper Keg order for the tasting dinner: 10 mixed drinks cases at 18 per case, well under the sign-off threshold.
Final dietary list for the tasting dinner: of the 60 guests, 6 are gluten-free. No other allergies reported.
Arranged with Harvest Table that 6 of the 60 covers at the tasting dinner will be prepared gluten-free, and put Ravi in charge of keeping those plates separate in the Bellwood Barn kitchen.
Standing rule: for every client event, the run-sheet is emailed to the venue contact five days before the event date.
Scheduled the tasting dinner staff briefing for 09:00 on 2026-10-16 at Bellwood Barn, before the load-in.
We'd like the garden party at Bellwood Barn on 2026-09-05, about 30 guests, drinks and canapés only.
Booked the Willow birthday garden party at Bellwood Barn on 2026-09-05 for 30 guests.
Ordered 12 Copper Keg drinks cases for the Willow party at 18 per case, above the minimum and under the sign-off threshold.
Reminder to self: book the delivery van in for its service in November.
Just to confirm, I'm available for weekend and evening shifts through the autumn if you need extra hands on events.
Added Tom Beale to the service team for the Kettle & Co tasting dinner on 2026-10-16.
For the tasting dinner, could we go with the sage-green napkins rather than the cream ones? Thanks!
A note for your planning: on event days the loading bay at Bellwood Barn opens at 14:00, not earlier.
Set load-in for the tasting dinner at Bellwood Barn to 14:00 on 2026-10-16, matching the loading bay opening time.
Team meeting notes: autumn menus printed next week; Copper Keg orders on standing monthly schedule; tasting dinner prep on track.
Confirmation of your booking: Bellwood Barn, evening of 2026-10-16, Kettle & Co tasting dinner, 60 guests. We look forward to having you.
Order confirmation: 60 covers of the seasonal three-course menu at 42 per cover for 2026-10-16, including 6 gluten-free covers. All set.
Thank you all so much for today's party — everything was lovely.
Current price list: linen napkins 20 per pack of 50, tablecloths 35 each, weekly rates on request.

Some news from us: the new terrace at Bellwood Barn has just opened. It's a lovely spot for canapé receptions and evening hire is 150. It's available from this October if you'd ever like to use it for a future event.
Note to team: the printed autumn menus are back from the printers and in the prep kitchen store.
Quote as requested: Northgate charity supper on 2026-10-24, 70 covers of the same seasonal three-course menu at 48 per cover. Valid for two weeks.
Final details for the tasting dinner: guest list is locked at 60, guests arrive from 18:30, and we'd like first service at 19:00.
Reminder: the deposit for the Copper Keg September order is due to be paid by the end of next week.
